Description: Unique sample identifier; used as the sample (column) names inside the counts and RPKM data files
Notes: Use this column to join meta data with counts and RPKM data. The tissue label in Sampleid is the label used when the data were generated and differs from Tissue for 4mo blood (Whole_Blood) and 4mo large intestine (Lgint); do not reconstruct Sampleid from other columns
WT = wild-type littermate control; Dp16 = Dp(16)1Yey
NA for E18.5 embryos (not yet born)
Age at harvest (Age_in_days) is derived in analysis scripts as Harvest_Date - DOB

Description: Mouse identifier within cage (postnatal) or within litter (embryonic)
Notes: Unique only in combination with Cage_ID

Description: Cage identifier (postnatal) or dam/litter cage identifier (embryonic)

Notes: Identifies an individual mouse; shared by all tissues from that mouse

Values_or_units: Blood; Brain; Heart; Intestine; Kidney; Large_Intestine; Liver; Lung; Skin; Whole_Embryo
Notes: Harmonized across timepoints. Intestine (E18.5) is whole intestine; Large_Intestine is collected at 1mo and 4mo; Skin and Whole_Embryo are E18.5 only

Description: RNA integrity number of the RNA sample
GEO SubSeries accession holding the counts and RPKM data for the sample's tissue-timepoint
Notes: SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE347972; NA where no SubSeries is listed (see Comment)
ALL-CAPS comments flag rows for review; NA if none
